statement_token: "Let $\\boldsymbol{\\tau}=(\\tau_1,\\tau_2,\\tau_3,\\ldots)$ be a partition, and let $X_\\lambda$ denote the variety associated with the partition $\\lambda$ in the algebra of generalized power sums. **Cohen–Macaulayness conjecture.** $X_\\lambda$ is Cohen–Macaulay if and only if one of the following holds: (1) $\\lambda=(m^{(r)},1^{(s)})$ with $r\\geq 1$ and $m>s\\geq 0$; (2) $\\lambda=(2^{(r)},1^{(s)})$ with $r\\geq 1$ and $s\\geq 0$; (3) $\\lambda=(2m,m^{(s)})$ with $m\\geq 1$. This conjecture summarizes the results of earlier work, the results established in the paper, and computer calculations; the converse classification remains open in the absence of a proof for all remaining partitions."
